recommendations.action: Work every day's call list in lead-score order and stop at capacity (200 calls/day assumed); never call in arrival or random order.
recommendations.evidence: With 1,000 calls for 2,310 test leads, score order reaches 77% of enrolments vs 43% at random.
recommendations.effect: Would add ~304 enrolments per 2,310 leads (~13 per 100 leads) with the same headcount; ₹27.3 lakh at assumed prices.

recommendations.action: Shift acquisition budget toward form-fill channels (Lead Add Form: Reference, Welingak) and test fixes for Olark Chat (qualifying questions in chat) before scaling it.
recommendations.evidence: Lead Add Form leads convert at 92% but are 8% of volume; Olark Chat is 19% of volume at 26%.
recommendations.effect: More high-intent leads per rupee of spend, if quality holds at higher volume (retrospective data: validate with a small budget-shift test).

recommendations.action: Treat counsellor capacity, not call cost, as the lever: before cutting calls, price one more counsellor (or a longer calling window) against the leads just below today's cutoff.
recommendations.evidence: A call breaks even at 1.7% conversion (assumed prices); the next 200 leads below the 1,000-call cutoff (ranks 1,001–1,200) still convert at 35%.
recommendations.effect: One extra counsellor (200 calls per batch) would reach ~70 more enrolments, ₹6.0 lakh before that counsellor's salary (assumed prices).
